stories.title: Federal agents search Rep. Ilhan Omar's DC home as part of a criminal investigation
stories.reason: Homeland Security Investigations agents executed the warrant 22 days before the midterms in a probe reportedly tied to immigration paperwork from her childhood, and Omar, who has not been charged, called it 'the latest escalation' in a campaign of political intimidation.

stories.title: Trump claims a Russia-Ukraine 'energy ceasefire,' but Moscow keeps striking Ukrainian gas facilities
stories.reason: Zelensky said Kyiv only learned of the announcement from the media and saw no sign Russia was complying, as a jet-powered drone hit a Kharkiv-region gas site hours later and Russian Foreign Minister Lavrov dismissed the idea outright.

stories.title: Fire destroys Paris's oldest covered food market, the historic Marche des Enfants Rouges
stories.reason: The overnight blaze collapsed part of the market's metal structure in the Marais district, a monument dating to 1615 that could stay closed for months, as officials investigate the cause and seek temporary space for displaced vendors.

stories.title: Amazon is in talks to acquire AI startup Decart for about $7 billion after Anthropic walked away
stories.reason: The price nearly doubles Decart's $4 billion valuation from May and comes as Amazon races to build out its Trainium AI chips to compete with Nvidia, with the world-model and chip-switching startup having first drawn a roughly $6 billion offer from Anthropic that fell through in due diligence.

stories.title: Microsoft unveils its Maia 300 AI chip, planning to deploy over a million to cut reliance on Nvidia
stories.reason: Unveiled at the OCP Global Summit, the in-house chip claims 40% more AI tokens per megawatt than leading GPU systems and is set to handle most of Microsoft's AI inference workloads from 2027, even as Nvidia remains the default for training its largest models.

stories.title: Le Pen and Melenchon head for France's 2027 presidential runoff as the political divide deepens, poll shows
stories.reason: The Toluna Harris Interactive poll projects Le Pen winning roughly 35-37% in the first round with Melenchon's far-left bid now reaching the runoff in every scenario tested, underscoring how a hollowed-out political center is ceding ground to hardline parties as Macron's term ends.

stories.title: A fourth Houthi strike in five days hits Riyadh's airport, killing one and wounding 11
stories.reason: Saudi forces shot down additional missiles aimed at the capital as King Khalid International Airport's closure was extended to at least October 17, deepening a crisis that began with Thursday's strike and Saturday's deadlier attack that killed 13.

stories.title: Nigerian fintech OPay files for a New York IPO targeting a $4 billion valuation
stories.reason: The SoftBank-backed company, whose first-half revenue jumped 137% to $467 million as lending overtook payments as its top earner, is testing Wall Street's appetite for African fintech with Standard Bank already agreeing to take up to a 4.99% stake.
